text: 8 Do you know? • Which is your favourite colour? • Have you seen a rainbow? Violet The Rainbow 1.6 Rainbow, rainbow, In the sky. Peeping out, As the clouds go by. Red, Orange, Yellow, Green and Blue, There is Indigo and Violet too! Yellow Green Red Orange Indigo Blue 1. Listen, sing and discuss. 2. Look and read. 3. Listen and write. rainbow peeping sky clouds orange indigo For the Teacher : • Encourage the children to ask questions based on the above poem.
